name: ChatGPT
description: ChatGPT is OpenAI's flagship generative-AI chatbot. OpenAI Global LLC is a US-based foreign private company (capped-profit, under the OpenAI nonprofit) with no Indian corporate registration; India is ChatGPT's largest user market (>72M daily users, late 2025).

stock.note: Private; filed a confidential S-1 June 8, 2026 (not yet public). Last primary valuation ~$852B post-money after a ~$122B round closed Mar 31, 2026.

marketing_spend.derivation: No India entity or PMAR listing, so Tiers 1-2 don't apply. TradingKey (2026) reported 2025 marketing expenditure 'surged 418% YoY' without an absolute figure. Applying a plausible 3-5% of 2025 revenue (~$13B, per leaked financials via MLQ/TradingKey) yields ~$0.4-0.65B global marketing spend; India-specific spend is not separately reported.

business_updates.headline: Filed confidential S-1; IPO targeted ~fall 2026 above $1T valuation
